text:
Elaine: Mock attached — compact streaming message row with an inline token mini-meter on the right. Stop/Regenerate in the message actions, ellipsis for more. Looking for quick UX + a11y signoff. Mike: Nice. Can we collapse the token meter into a tooltip on hover for mobile? Mobile real estate is tight. Elaine: Yeah — idea is show small token dot + count on hover, full meter on desktop. For mobile it'll be a tap-to-expand pattern. Sam: Question: what label for the stop control? 'Stop' vs 'Pause' vs 'Stop generation' Tania: I vote 'Stop' — clearer. 'Pause' implies you can resume streaming mid-response which we don't support. Jordan: Agree with Stop. Also change 'Regenerate' to 'Regenerate response' in tooltip for clarity. Mike: Accessibility: need aria-live on the streaming container and aria-labels for the stop button. Also keyboard focus should move to the toolbar after generation starts. Elaine: Adding example aria props: ```
...streaming tokens...
``` Sam: For screen readers, the token meter shouldn't be noisy. Announce only milestones (e.g., '50 tokens generated') not every token. Tania: Copy nit: the token compact shows '12/2048' now — can we change to '12 tokens' and surface overall limit in tooltip? Users scan faster for current token usage. Jordan: For prompt bank — proposal to rename to 'Prompt Bank' -> 'Quick Prompts' and add categories + keyboard shortcut (/) to open. Thoughts? Elaine: +1 to 'Quick Prompts' — more discoverable. Also add small preview snippets in the dropdown. Mike: Telemetry: track events: playground.prompt_open, prompt_insert, stop_click, regenerate_click, token_meter_expand. Add property `streaming: true/false`. Sam: Visual: consider collapsing long messages into a 'Show more' rather than full inline regen to avoid layout jumps when streaming Tania: A11y checklist: focus order, aria-live behavior, visible focus ring, color contrast for meter (needs 4.5:1), screen reader friendly labels. Jordan: I'll iterate on the mock and put a prototype in Figma by EOD. Can someone from Eng comment on complexity of keyboard focus change? Mike: Should be low — move focus programmatically to toolbar element on start, remember previous focus on stop. DesignBot: Reminder: file naming for assets -> /design/playground/compact-stream-v2.fig Elaine: Thanks — I'll update the mock with the aria snippets and copy changes. Ping me for a quick review when ready :thumbsup:
